import os,subprocess,tempfile,time,json
start=time.monotonic()
def run(args,timeout=180):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError("Command failed: "+str(args[:3])+" error "+p.stderr[-1300:])
 return p.stdout.strip()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="issuestack-inventory-") as t:
 repo=os.path.join(t,"src.git")
 run(["git","-c","protocol.version=2","clone","--bare","--filter=blob:none","--no-tags","https://github.com/BestNameYet/IssueStack-.git",repo],200)
 print("CLONE_SECONDS",round(time.monotonic()-start,2))
 refs=run(["git","--git-dir",repo,"for-each-ref","refs/heads","--format=%(refname:short) %(objectname)"]).splitlines()
 print("BRANCH_COUNT",len(refs),"EXAMPLES",refs[:3])
 ref=next((x.split()[1] for x in refs if x.startswith("main ")),None)
 if not ref:raise RuntimeError("main not found")
 for path in ["src/agent-context-registry.js",".github/workflows/commit-workflow-discovery-listener.yml","src/interactive-procedures.js"]:
  print("LOG",path,run(["git","--git-dir",repo,"log","-1","--date=iso-strict","--format=%H %cI",ref,"--",path])[:200])
 print("TOTAL_SECONDS",round(time.monotonic()-start,2))
